items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: And so afterwards I think I thought sort of the doomsday humor, Stanley Kubrick humor I guess.

ctx.x: Well if you remember the Reagan era, Reagan and Brezhnev doesn’t seem like so different again. I knew that my alto sax player at that time named Ed Jackson loved to play over the changes of “What is This Thing Called Love.” And I wanted to write – that’s what it is, I wanted to write something more along the lines of like Tristano might write over that, like a “Subconscious-Lee” basically. And so I just wrote this crazy line on “What is This Thing Called Love” and then I realized oh I want the first entire chorus…

That’s good, Stanley Kubrick humor, yeah. Do you have a sense of what you hope listeners get from your music? I asked this question to Ran Blake and he said, “As long as I don’t bore the listener I’m somewhat happy.”
